differences.what: place and bearing: one house on the north bank east of the forks, end-on to the lake, its fenced green and two poplars on its river side, across the river from the fort; the build's east gable lands on the drawn apex within about 9 px from this camera

length: the plate draws the house from its east gable to the end of its north eave over about 62 px (x 1087-1150), the build's runs to x 1167 from this camera; the Teich painting also draws the front shorter against its end than the build does. At 40 px on a blurred scan this is not a measurement, and the 40-foot length stays as its liberty records (T-2516)
walls, openings, stacks and piazza: the scan is too blurred at this size to show any of them

the house's walls drawn as from near their own height while its ground is laid out as from the air (the north eave falls away to the right, 15 px off the camera): the lithograph's own drawing, which no single camera reproduces

the paling round the green on the house's river side and the two poplars at its west end (x 1060-1080 px), and the trees behind it: built outside this GLB, as kinzie_house_1812_green and data/flora/plantings/kinzie_house_1812_trees.json (four poplars there, after Currey and the 1857 engraving, where this plate draws two)
colour: hand-coloured later; the colours are a nineteenth-century addition and not evidence (chicago/reference/images/IMAGE_SOURCES.md)

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown}. A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
